description: This file defines an Angular component called TraceViewComponent that manages a UI for displaying trace views with tabs and overlays, including rendering logic, event handling, and interactions with viewers and persistent storage.

classes.name: TraceViewComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for visualizing trace data with tabbed and overlay views, supporting interactions and dynamic rendering of viewer contents.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates the tab and overlay views when input properties change.

methods.name: onTabClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking a tab to display its associated view.

methods.name: renderViewsTab
methods.description: Builds the tabs array from viewers' views filtered by type, associating store and initializing the first tab.

methods.name: renderViewsOverlay
methods.description: Attaches overlay views to the overlay container, ensuring only one overlay, and making it pointer-events enabled.

methods.name: showTab
methods.description: Activates the selected tab, manages display styles, and emits an activeViewChanged event.

methods.name: isCurrentActiveTab
methods.description: Checks if the provided tab is the current active tab.
